# Delivery Excellence

Transform ideas into valuable outcomes predictably and efficiently.

---

## Principles

- [Customer Value First](../principles/customer-value-first.md) — measure success by outcomes, not outputs
- Deliver value early — small releases with fast feedback loops
- Reduce work in progress — finishing work creates value, starting work creates activity
- Make progress visible — everyone should know what is being worked on and why

---

## Agile Practices

Focus on outcomes and feedback, not ceremonies for their own sake.

### Backlog Management

Good backlog items contain:
- Clear objective
- Defined scope
- Acceptance criteria
- Business value

### Sprint Planning

Outputs:
- Sprint goal
- Committed work
- Risks identified

### Backlog Refinement

- Recommended cadence: weekly
- Purpose: clarify requirements, reduce uncertainty, improve estimation quality

### Retrospectives

- What worked?
- What did not work?
- What should change?

Improvement actions must be tracked. See → [Continuous Improvement](../principles/continuous-improvement.md)

## Strong Signals

- Predictable delivery with small, regular releases
- Clear priorities and transparent progress
- Few surprises for stakeholders

## Weak Signals

- Constant deadline slippage
- Excessive context switching
- Large unfinished projects
- Hidden risks
